name: Reckon All-in-One Suite (Filter -> White-Label PDF Audit -> GEO Fix Kit)

parameters.content:
## Reckon All-in-One Suite (Apify) — Quick Setup

1. Get your Apify API token from https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations
2. Add `APIFY_TOKEN` to your n8n environment variables (or replace `{{$env.APIFY_TOKEN}}` in the HTTP node URL).
3. Put your prospect URLs or Google Maps leads in the JSON body and click **Execute Workflow**.

**What you get:** Opportunity score (healthy sites auto-dropped), verified email/phone, clickable white-label PDF audit (`report_pdf_url`), and AI-Search `llms.txt` + JSON-LD fix kit (`geo_kit.llms_txt_url`).

Actor Page: https://apify.com/krazyarcher/reckon-all-in-one-suite
